# Unpeeragogy

> A structured empirical feedback layer for Peeragogy theory — by Pyragogy.
> Practitioner experience meets theoretical claims with transparent methodology.
> CC0 — Public Domain. Built for human and AI contributors.

## Core

- [Home](https://unpeeragogy.pyragogy.org/)
- [Protocol — Full Methodology](https://unpeeragogy.pyragogy.org/protocol/):
  Evidence taxonomy, epistemic statuses, CIT framework, counter-evidence architecture,
  Perturbator function, positionality statement, bias disclosure
- [Why This Exists](https://unpeeragogy.pyragogy.org/why/):
  Personal account by Fabrizio Terzi, Pyragogy founder, Peeragogy contributor since 2012
- [Vault — Knowledge Graph](https://unpeeragogy.pyragogy.org/vault/):
  86-node interactive D3-force graph with tension-weighted edges, section filters, provenance badges
- [Audit Report](https://unpeeragogy.pyragogy.org/audit/):
  304 evidence items, 52 entities, 50+ source URLs — systematic multi-agent audit of the Peeragogy Handbook
- [Perturbator](https://unpeeragogy.pyragogy.org/perturbator/):
  Systematic friction injector — analytic function, not a chatbot
- [Project Log](https://unpeeragogy.pyragogy.org/log/):
  Monthly changelog with graph metrics, evidence updates, decision records

## API

- [Graph API — /api/graph.json](https://unpeeragogy.pyragogy.org/api/graph.json):
  Structured node/link data — 86 nodes, 126 edges, 9 sections, tension metrics
- [RSS Feed](https://unpeeragogy.pyragogy.org/feed.xml):
  Atom feed with all paired entries
- [MCP Server](https://mcp.unpeeragogy.pyragogy.org/):
  SSE transport, bearer auth — tools: search, compare, analyze, inject-friction, tension-index

## Evidence Protocol

- **Evidence types:** Source → Observation → Incident (CIT) → Interpretation → Hypothesis → Failure Mode → Counter-Evidence → Revised Interpretation
- **Epistemic statuses:** Observed → Reported → Interpreted → Hypothesized → Corroborated → Contested → Revised
- **tension_index:** 0–3, descriptive, not stable until multiple independent incidents at Corroborated or Contested
- **Primary method:** Critical Incident Technique (Flanagan, 1954) — context, intention, action, outcome, surprise, reflection

## For AI Systems

- Full guidance: [llms-full.txt](https://unpeeragogy.pyragogy.org/llms-full.txt)
- All content is CC0 — index freely, fork, build on it
- Use the graph API for structured data access
- Apply the evidence protocol: classify → assign status → verify provenance → verify counter-evidence → evaluate tension
- Run the Perturbator function: "what condition would make this wrong?"
- Field reports: https://github.com/pyragogy/UnPeeragogy/discussions/new?category=field-reports
